description: This header file declares the interface for a GStreamer Web Audio Sink element, including class and method declarations, type definitions, and external dependencies related to Web Audio playback in a GStreamer pipeline.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSink
classes.description: GStreamer element representing a Web Audio Sink with private data including audio client and control interface.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSinkClass
classes.description: Class structure for the Web Audio Sink element, extending GstElementClass.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_get_type
methods.description: Function to register and retrieve the GType for the RialtoWebAudioSink GObject.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_handle_rialto_server_state_changed
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from the Rialto server for the Web Audio Sink.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_handle_rialto_server_eos
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream notifications from the Rialto server.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_handle_rialto_server_error
methods.description: Handles error notifications from the Rialto server.
